how_to_edit: Edit by hand after testing a model on real games. recommended = best models, tier_picks says which one the app highlights for 8, 12 and 16+ GB of VRAM (each pick must be in recommended). tier_picks is the default for any target language and must only name models that work for every language (older app versions read only this). tier_picks_by_language overrides it for one target language, e.g. English; each pick must be in recommended and support that language. languages (optional, on an entry) lists the target languages the model is good for; leave it out for all languages. specialist = JP to EN fine-tunes. experimental = not recommended or not yet tested. vram_gb = download size + about 1.5 GB. tag = exact Ollama tag, letters, digits and . _ : / - only. Verify a tag exists before adding it.
